target_customer: Financial services firms with document heavy work (private equity, private credit, asset managers); later software teams using AI coding agents
problem: Investment firms extract and analyze structured finance data from documents by hand; later, teams need to manage parallel AI coding agents.
business_model: Enterprise SaaS with SaaS, single tenant and in-VPC deployment options
product_category: AI document data platform for finance; AI agent management layer

founders.name: He Lu
prior_employers: Blue Water Fintech (co-founder and CTO, acquired 2022)
founders.background_notes: YC page says he earlier managed five institutional trading books as a portfolio manager.

technical_complexity.rationale: Extracting structured data from credit agreements and pitchbooks with traceable sources is standard document AI engineering with accuracy challenges; the team had strong data science credentials.

defensibility.rationale: Enterprise deployment options and SOC 2 add some friction to switching, but document extraction is widely offered and general models improved quickly.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or direct copy found; the company later added coSlash, a management layer for AI coding agents.

market_need_then: Banks and investment firms process large volumes of financial documents manually, and language models made structured extraction newly feasible in 2023 and 2024.

identity.voice_and_tone: Enterprise and human in command: 'Intelligence for Work That Matters'

brand_strength.rationale: Generic astronomy name shared with many other companies, and the flagship product brand coSlash is separate; no press about the brand was found.

pivots.from: Data platform for structured finance and investment firms
pivots.to: Also coSlash, a management layer for AI coding agents
